svg.title: Curiosity Beetle Cabinet — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: Nine jewel beetles arranged in a warm Victorian specimen cabinet. Full-color library preview; open the SVG to use the numbered mandala-style worksheet. Click a region to apply its suggested color. Shift-click to clear it.
